CheckTitle: Ensure Shared EPM Accounts Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
SubSectionName: Application Business User Separation of Duties (SoD)
RequiredAccess: EPM Cloud access (EPM Automate, Service Administrator)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: EPM accounts used by more than one person should be detected and monitored.
Risk: Shared accounts make it impossible to tell who performed an action.
AuditProcedure: Identify accounts used by more than one person.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 45001, 45002.

Steps: Inactivate the account or reset its password for a single owner; review actions since sharing began.
